cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(fist_regression C)
enable_testing()
add_executable(fist-test fist_test.c)
target_include_directories(fist-test PRIVATE ../../templates/runtime ../../src)
if(NOT WIN32)
    target_link_libraries(fist-test PRIVATE m)
endif()
add_test(NAME guest-fist-rounding COMMAND fist-test)
